searchText: Ethereum Protocol Fellowship has done 5 cohorts with the latest just finished up. Look out for it next year. https://blog.ethereum.org/2024/05/13/epf-5-announcement To start studying: https://epf.wiki There is an internship program but this is aimed at people with less experience: https://blog.ethereum.org/2024/11/16/announcing-ef-internship-program Thanks for sharing these resources! The Ethereum Protocol Fellowship sounds like an amazing program—I’ll definitely take a closer look at the wiki and start exploring. The internship program is interesting too; even with experience, there’s always more to learn. Appreciate the pointers!
